title: fix(cli): the ready banner prints API: and MCP: addresses only when an HTTP server is composed
body:
Fixes #23623
Clause-②: no

## What this changes

`os serve`'s ready banner printed `API:` and an MCP connect URL on every boot. That included `--no-server`, where no HTTP server is composed and nothing listens on the port. Triage's scope, verbatim: "**Scope:** the API and MCP lines appear only when an HTTP server is composed. Otherwise the banner says none is served, once. Pin both shapes."

- **`packages/cli/src/utils/format.ts`.** Adds a required field to `ServerReadyOptions`: `httpServer: HttpServerComposition`, one of `'composed' | 'skipped-by-no-server' | 'not-composed'`. `printServerReady` prints the address rows only for `'composed'`. The address rows are `API:`, `Console:`, `MCP:` with its connect hint, and the paths-only note. Otherwise it prints none of them, and one line: `➜  No HTTP server: --no-server was given and no plugin composed one, so no API or MCP address is served`. For `'not-composed'`, the `--no-server was given and` clause is left out. The ready line and every row that names no address do not change.
- **`packages/cli/src/commands/serve.ts`.** Adds `readComposedHttpServer(kernel)`, which is the `http.server` read `resolveBoundPort` already did, moved into its own function. `resolveBoundPort` and the new `resolveHttpServerComposition(kernel, flags.server)` both call it, and the banner thunk gets `httpServer` from it. The answer comes from the booted kernel, not from `flags.server`. A config that mounts its own `HonoServerPlugin` under `--no-server` has a registered `http.server`, so its address rows still print. `flags.server` only decides whether the line names `--no-server`. Two comments said the banner's `API:` row always names the bound address; they now say when it does.
- ⛔ Not changed: the `objectstack:listening` IPC message, `runtime.ENV.PROJECT.json` (`publishBoundPort`), flags, exit codes, exports and `packages/spec`. `utils/format.ts` is not a published export of `@objectstack/cli`.
- **`.changeset/23623-no-server-banner-urls.md`.** An `@objectstack/cli` patch describing the banner's two shapes.

### One departure from the dispatch's suggested route

The dispatch suggested an optional field whose default keeps today's output. This PR makes the field **required** instead. The defect is that a missing fact is read as "a server is listening". An optional field that defaults to `'composed'` would bring that back for the next caller that leaves it out. The same interface already does this for `externalBaseOrigin`: "Required on purpose: an absent field must not be able to mean `http://localhost:PORT` again by omission." The cost is one `httpServer: 'composed'` line in the base literal of 13 existing banner pins. `tsc` named 11 of them; the other two cast with `as ServerReadyOptions` and were found by reading. None of their assertions changed.

## Measured shapes

Each boot ran `node packages/cli/bin/run.js serve objectstack.config.ts --port PORT ARGS` on the built CLI, spawned with an IPC channel. `NODE_ENV` was unset except under `--dev`, and `OS_CLOUD_URL=off`. The fixture is a throwaway host config with one object and one plugin instance. Before is base `9bb93706f`; after is `30b5c246e`. The port probe is a `GET` sent right after the banner, before the child is stopped.

| Shape | Before: address rows | After: address rows | Port probe (before and after) |
|---|---|---|---|
| production `--no-server --preset minimal` (the card's command) | `API: http://localhost:PORT/`, `MCP: http://localhost:PORT/api/v1/mcp` and the connect hint | `➜  No HTTP server: --no-server was given and no plugin composed one, so no API or MCP address is served` | `ECONNREFUSED` on `/`, `/api/v1/health`, `/api/v1/mcp` |
| `--dev --no-server` | `API:`, `MCP:` and the hint | the same one line | `ECONNREFUSED` on all three |
| production default, `OS_DATABASE_URL` and an auth secret (control) | `API:`, `MCP:` and the hint | unchanged | `/` 302, `/api/v1/health` 200, `/api/v1/mcp` 401 |
| production `--no-server --preset minimal` with a config that mounts its own `HonoServerPlugin` (control) | `API:`, `MCP:` and the hint | unchanged | `/` 404, `/api/v1/health` 404, `/api/v1/mcp` 404, `/api/v1/data/fx_task` 401 |

## Tests

Everything below ran on `30b5c246e` (HEAD), after `pnpm turbo run build --filter=@objectstack/cli` (61 tasks, exit 0).

- **`src/utils/format.server-ready-no-http-server.test.ts`** (new, unit):
  - the composed shape: rows as before, and the paths-only note still prints;
  - `skipped-by-no-server` with `mcpEnabled: true`, `uiEnabled` and `consolePath`: no address row, no `http://` anywhere, exactly one line, and it names `--no-server`;
  - `not-composed`: one line, and it does not name `--no-server`;
  - the paths-only note is dropped along with the rows;
  - four cases checking that the composed banner minus its address rows equals the no-server banner minus its line, for healthy and DEGRADED boots.
- **`src/commands/serve-http-server-composition.test.ts`** (new, unit):
  - `http.server` registered gives `composed`, whatever the flag;
  - nothing registered under `--no-server` gives `skipped-by-no-server`;
  - nothing registered with the flag on gives `not-composed`;
  - only the canonical name is asked for, the same one `resolveBoundPort` asks for;
  - only the deprecated `http-server` alias registered gives `not-composed`.
- **`src/commands/serve-no-server-banner.integration.test.ts`** (new). `vitest-tiers.ts`'s predicate puts it in the integration tier. It boots the built CLI four times, once per shape in the table:
  - production `--no-server` and `--dev --no-server`: no `API:`, `Console:` or `MCP:` row, no connect hint, and one line naming `--no-server`;
  - the default control: an `MCP:` row, and the `API:` port answers health with 200;
  - the config-mounted Hono control: no no-server line, and the `API:` port answers HTTP.

  It declares `// test-budget: 30`: two local runs took 16.1 s and 16.5 s on a shared container, times 1.25, rounded up. It lives under `src/` because the dispatch's file surface is `packages/cli/src/**`. `src/` cannot import `test/helpers/serve-process.ts`, so its env strip and port probe are local, as in `src/commands/migrate/*.integration.test.ts`.
- **New and touched banner pins:** `vitest run` over the 17 files: `Test Files 17 passed (17)`, `Tests 202 passed (202)`.
- **Unit layer:** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project unit --maxWorkers=2 --shard=K/4`, for K = 1 to 4. It is sharded because one unsharded run ran past the container's 10-minute foreground cap. Files: 75 + 74 + 74 + 74. Tests: 1369 + 1079 + 886 + 1043 = 4377, all passed.
- **Integration, scoped.** The diff adds an integration-tier file and edits `serve.ts`; the rest of that tier is CI's. I ran the new pin plus four existing `.integration` files: `test/serve-no-storage-boot-guard`, `serve-host-config-metadata-door`, `serve-view-container-read` and `serve-migrate-exit-schema-parity`. Result: `Test Files 5 passed (5)`, `Tests 22 passed (22)`.
- **Typecheck:** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli typecheck`, exit 0 (`tsc --noEmit`, then `check:test-typecheck: OK`). `--listFilesOnly` counts the three new files in the `tsc` program.
- **Ablation**, run after the fix was committed, through `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` in wrap mode (it restores on exit):
  - Mutation: the `API:` row moved back above `if (opts.httpServer === 'composed')`, so it prints unconditionally again, with a marker comment. Anchor x1 to x0; blob `be095f8d3d42` to `f3a63ad76d42`.
  - After rebuilding the CLI, `node scripts/ablation-dist-preflight.mjs @objectstack/cli 'ablation-23623'` found the marker in 1 built file.
  - The two pins: `Tests 9 failed | 4 passed (13)`. All 7 no-server unit cases and both no-server boots failed with `an address row printed`; the composed cases and both boot controls passed.
  - Restore: blob back to `be095f8d3d42`, which is HEAD; `git diff HEAD` and `git status --porcelain` both empty. After a rebuild, preflight `--absent` found the marker in none of the 636 built files, and the pins passed: `Tests 13 passed (13)`.

## Gates

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` on `30b5c246e` derives 66 commands. Each exit code was recorded before any pipe, and all 66 exited 0. `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `pnpm check:i18n-coverage` first exited 3 (`PREREQUISITE NOT MET`: packages outside the CLI's closure had no `dist/`); after those were built, both exited 0. `--ran` reports `66 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 66 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED`.
- **Lint:** `pnpm exec eslint packages/cli --no-inline-config` exited 0 with no output. `--format json` over the five changed code files reports 0 messages, and `--print-config` shows active rules for them. Repo-wide `pnpm lint` is CI's.
- CI check-runs: not read yet; they start when this PR opens.

## Acceptance notes

- **The machine channels on a `--no-server` boot were read, not changed.** The `objectstack:listening` IPC message is still sent as `{ type: 'objectstack:listening', port: PORT, url: 'http://localhost:PORT' }`, for a port nothing listens on. `content/docs/deployment/cli.mdx` documents that message as "The HTTP server is bound." `runtime.env_local.PROJECT.json` is written with the same `port` and `url`. The message's only in-repo consumer is the `os dev` parent, and it never spawns a `--no-server` child (`os dev` has no `server` flag). Reported to the seat in the `os-dev-report`.
- **A config-mounted `HonoServerPlugin` under `--no-server`.** Per the ruling, this shape prints `API:` and `MCP:`, and the `API:` row is pinned. Measured: the `API:` port answers (a REST data route returns 401), but `/api/v1/mcp` returns 404, because the dispatcher that mounts it is composed only under `--server`. So in this shape the `MCP:` row names a route that is not mounted. It is not changed here, since the ruling keeps the row, and it is not pinned: the integration control checks only the `API:` row. Reported to the seat.
- **Production `--no-server --preset minimal` exits on its own.** Measured on both base and after, with and without an IPC channel: the banner's last line, `Press Ctrl+C to stop`, printed 3134 ms after spawn, and the process exited 0 at 3175 ms. `--dev --no-server` (default preset) stays up. That last line is outside this card's scope; reported to the seat.
- A comment in `start.ts` says `printServerReady` "prints the `API:` row always". That is still true for `os start`, which never passes `--no-server`, so it is left as is.
